Capability-pack runtime installer: interactive TUI provisioning of native runtimes before merge-install — Autoharness must actually install/upgrade external capability-pack runtimes/binaries, not merely compose their instruction/agent overlays. Provide an interactive TUI checklist before merge-install where users check/uncheck capability packs. For each selected pack, first scan for pre-existing installations, detect existence and installed version, then offer an appropriate per-pack action: fresh install, upgrade, retain/skip, or clearly report unsupported/unavailable installation. Coordinate provisioning of selected pack runtimes BEFORE the merge-install workflow so a new customer devbox becomes operational without expert tool-specific setup knowledge. Initial explicitly named native runtimes: backlogit, agent-engram/engram, graphtor-docs. UX and docs must make installation order explicit: provision selected pack runtimes before composing/merge-installing their harness overlays.

CURRENT GAP: deploy preflight only advisory-checks backlogit, engram, and graphtor-docs; it does not download, install, upgrade, pin, checksum-verify, or provision models.

OPEN DESIGN QUESTIONS (preserve for later Stage deliberation — do NOT silently decide): supported OS/platform matrix; authoritative package/download sources; version/channel policy; pinning, checksums/signature verification and supply-chain safety; user-local vs system install and elevation; PATH refresh; offline/proxy/customer-network constraints; embedding-model provisioning for graphtor-docs; rollback/partial-failure semantics; non-interactive/headless/CI equivalent to the TUI; idempotence; upgrade compatibility; licensing/consent; whether autoharness itself is bootstrapped before the runtime-provisioning phase while still ensuring pack runtimes precede merge-install composition.

OPERATOR INTAKE (2026-08-11, verbatim): "Consider implementing a DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) to keep the agent from spinning in reasoning circles over the same information."

CLASSIFICATION (conservative, Stage): FEATURE/SPIKE CANDIDATE — not yet triaged, not planned, not harvested, and deliberately NOT associated with PR #325. Recorded as intake only per operator instruction.

CANDIDATE SCOPE (framing only, not a decomposition): bounded reasoning-state traversal; duplicate-state detection (recognising that a state materially equivalent to one already visited is being re-entered); cycle prevention (a DAG/visited-set discipline over reasoning states so revisits are structurally impossible rather than discouraged); and OBSERVABLE TERMINATION (the agent can demonstrate it stopped because a bound was reached or the frontier was exhausted, rather than merely appearing to stop).

WHY IT LIKELY NEEDS A SPIKE BEFORE A PLAN: the hard part is not the graph, it is defining reasoning-state IDENTITY — what counts as "the same information" — plus where the traversal boundary sits relative to existing agent step contracts, and how termination is made observable rather than asserted. Those are open questions, so this is a spike candidate rather than a ready-to-plan feature.

PROVENANCE NOTE (supporting evidence, not a decision): the PR #325 Stage sessions are a concrete motivating case — fifteen-plus review passes never reached a fixed point, and repeated fix-then-refalsify cycles were ended by operator authority rather than by any convergence property of the process itself.

STATUS: intake only. No triage, no routing, no planning, no harvest, no shipment association performed. The hard problem is defining reasoning-state IDENTITY (what counts as 'the same information'), where the traversal boundary sits relative to existing agent step contracts, and how termination is made OBSERVABLE rather than asserted. Those are open questions, so an impl-plan would be speculative and a plan-review could not meaningfully gate it. Not routed to a spike this session because a spike consumes the same operator-selection authority the other deferred capabilities are waiting on, and this session's eligible high-priority work (BED0DDED) was already unblocked by hard external evidence. RELATED PRIOR ART for whoever runs the spike: the existing circuit-breaker and escalation-protocol instructions already bound repetition by COUNTING attempts (stop conditions, 3-consecutive-failure escalation, 3-review-cycle limits) rather than by detecting state EQUIVALENCE -- the delta this entry proposes is equivalence detection and observable frontier exhaustion, which is exactly why it needs a spike first. Entry stays ACTIVE at MEDIUM priority. Unblocker: operator selection of this as a lead capability, then spike -> impl-plan -> plan-harden -> plan-review -> harvest. [STAGE DARK-FACTORY RE-TRIAGE 2026-08-15 (P-017; route claude-opus-5/anthropic/high; append-only, all prior text preserved above)] CLASSIFICATION RE-CONFIRMED AS SPIKE-FIRST -- NOT PLANNED, NOT HARVESTED, AND NO SPIKE RUN THIS SESSION; ENTRY STAYS ACTIVE AT MEDIUM PRIORITY. This is a third independent Stage triage reaching the same conclusion, and it was reached by re-examining the evidence rather than by deferring to the prior annotations. REVISED RATIONALE FOR NOT SPIKING (the 2026-08-14 rationale is superseded, not repeated): the prior annotation declined to spike on the grounds that a spike would consume the same operator-selection authority the other deferred capabilities await. That reasoning is WRONG and is corrected here -- a spike is a non-destructive, planning-only, Stage-owned instrument, explicitly within Stage's authority and explicitly permitted by this session's operator directive to spike as appropriate, so operator-selection authority is NOT the blocker. The ACTUAL blocker is evidentiary: the central open question is reasoning-state IDENTITY (what counts as materially "the same information"), and answering it requires observing instrumented agent runs to see which states actually recur. No such instrumentation exists in this workspace, and none can be produced by read-only inspection while the operator is AFK. A spike run under those conditions could only emit an unfalsifiable opinion about state identity, which would be speculation wearing a spike's label -- strictly worse than an honest deferral, because a PROCEED verdict backed by no measurement would then be treated downstream as a gate that had been passed. NAMED FIRST QUESTION FOR WHOEVER RUNS THE SPIKE (framing only, NOT a decomposition and NOT an authorization to harvest): the three candidate-scope elements are separable, and OBSERVABLE TERMINATION is the most tractable and is largely INDEPENDENT of solving state identity. This repository already bounds repetition by COUNTING (circuit-breaker instructions, the 3-consecutive-failure escalation protocol, the 3-review-cycle plan-review limit, and the Stage 20-task/3-failure stop conditions), but those bounds are ASSERTED in prose rather than emitted as machine-checkable termination evidence. The spike should therefore first determine whether a termination-record contract over the ALREADY-EXISTING bounds delivers most of the reliability benefit at a fraction of the blast radius, and only then decide whether duplicate-state detection and a full DAG/visited-set traversal are warranted. That question is answerable from repository evidence alone and is the recommended entry point. SAFETY NOTE FOR THE EVENTUAL IMPLEMENTATION (not a blocker for the spike itself): a mechanism that governs when agents stop reasoning is authority-expanding runtime behavior, so the implementation -- unlike the spike -- will require explicit operator consent regardless of how strong the spike's findings are. Entry stays ACTIVE at MEDIUM priority. Unblocker unchanged: operator selection of this as a lead capability, then spike -> impl-plan -> plan-harden -> plan-review -> harvest. This session did NOT repeat the prior deferrals: it executed the read-only, Stage-owned spike that the 2026-08-15 annotation recommended, on the specific question that annotation named as answerable from repository evidence alone. Findings artifact: docs/decisions/2026-08-16-observable-termination-record-spike.md (passes backlogit docs lint --profile authoring with zero findings). RESULT: the 2026-08-15 hypothesis is HALF-CONFIRMED AND HALF-REFUTED, and its recommended first slice is WITHDRAWN. Confirmed: (F1) every repetition bound in this harness -- circuit-breaker retry threshold, 3-consecutive-failure escalation, 3-cycle plan-review limit, Stage 20-task/3-failure stop conditions -- is asserted in PROSE ONLY; a token scan across src/, schemas/ and .github/ finds no machine-readable termination construct, and install-harness SKILL.md line 380 states the circuit-breaker cooldown is deliberately "rendered into instruction prose rather than parsed as machine configuration". (F2) a mature structured emission substrate already exists in src/autoharness/telemetry/ with an established degrade-open discipline. (F3) observable termination IS genuinely separable from the unsolved reasoning-state-identity problem. REFUTED: (F4) the blast radius is NOT small -- because the bounds live in prose, an emission contract can only be introduced by editing the constitution, circuit-breaker and escalation instructions plus the Stop Conditions section of every agent template and their templates/ counterparts, i.e. the core behavioural contract surface of every agent the product generates. (F5) DECISIVE -- there is no consumer, so emission would be write-only telemetry that yields the APPEARANCE of reliability rather than reliability. (F6) the motivating evidence (PR #325 fifteen-plus non-converging review passes; and four consecutive Stage sessions re-triaging these same entries to identical conclusions) is real but does not discriminate: neither failure was caused by missing termination EVIDENCE, both by the absence of an ENFORCED bound -- which is precisely the authority-expanding mechanism reserved for operator consent. NARROWED NEXT SLICE for whoever picks this up: pick ONE bound (the plan-review 3-cycle limit is best -- most mechanical, Stage-owned, and it already has a natural carrier artifact), ship the READER in the same slice or ship neither, keep it record-only and degrade-open per the record.py precedent, and do NOT attempt duplicate-state detection or a DAG/visited-set traversal until that has shipped and produced real measurements. Reasoning-state identity remains unanswerable from static repository evidence and was not attempted. SAFETY NOTE REAFFIRMED: any mechanism that GOVERNS when agents stop reasoning is authority-expanding runtime behaviour and requires explicit operator consent; F6 shows the enforcing variant is the valuable half, which makes that consent a hard gate rather than a formality. [STAGE DELIBERATION 2026-08-25 (route claude-opus-5/anthropic/high; append-only, all prior text preserved above)] DELIBERATED THIS SESSION -- DELIBERATION ARTIFACT 028-DL CREATED AND LINKED; ENTRY REFINED, NOT SPLIT, NOT HARVESTED, NOT ARCHIVED; STAYS ACTIVE AT MEDIUM PRIORITY. Durable artifact: docs/decisions/2026-08-25-pr-review-convergence-finding-ledger-deliberation.md. Operator supplied a sharper hypothesis (record DAG nodes in backlogit's SQLite to track issue-resolution convergence during the PR review cycle) and asked whether that is a naive DAG missing other mechanisms. ANSWER: YES, NAIVE -- and the deliberation names the missing mechanisms. CENTRAL FINDING: the observed non-termination is NOT state revisitation, so a visited-set/cycle detector would have fired ZERO times across PR #325 (15+ rounds), #229 (13), #328 (5) and #348 (7). Every finding is a genuinely NEW node; the process is a non-terminating productive descent under a regenerating external oracle. Acyclicity implies termination ONLY over a finite FIXED node set, and here the node set is generated on demand by Copilot as a function of HEAD. Termination therefore needs a WELL-FOUNDED MONOTONE MEASURE, which acyclicity cannot supply. RECOMMENDED MODEL: ledger + epoch + measure delivers TERMINATION; the DAG delivers EXPLANATION (supersedes/regression_of edges plus SCC detection catch fix-A-breaks-B thrash -- the one genuine cycle that CAN occur, and where the operator's DAG instinct is correct). TWO FURTHER CORRECTIONS: (i) four distinct graphs were being collided -- the work-item dependency DAG ALREADY EXISTS (item_deps, 488 blocks edges, reader = autoharness gate dag-readiness with cycle detection/ready-set/critical path) and must not be polluted with runtime evidence semantics; the review-finding graph is the correct target and is the ONLY one of the four whose node IDENTITY is already solved, because GitHub assigns stable review-thread node IDs; (ii) backlogit's SQLite is a DISPOSABLE CACHE rehydrated from markdown by sync_index (963 items rehydrated this session), so records written only there are destroyed by the next sync -- as literally stated the hypothesis is a data-loss architecture. GAP CONFIRMED IN EXISTING GATES: gates/copilot_review.py is a CURRENT-STATE predicate (is the frontier empty now?) and never a convergence measure (is the frontier shrinking?), so it passes cleanly on the final round of a 15-round divergent loop. THE FOUR-SESSION BLOCKER IS DISSOLVED: the 2026-08-15 annotation deferred this entry because answering it required instrumented agent runs that do not exist. For the PR-REVIEW framing that blocker DOES NOT APPLY -- GitHub already holds the complete round-by-round review history of every PR this harness has shipped, and P-009 forbids squash/rebase so commit history is preserved. Nothing needs to be instrumented. NEXT INSTRUMENT (Stage-ownable, read-only, NOT run this session): a report-only 'autoharness gate review-convergence <pr>' analyzer emitting new_findings_per_round plus CONVERGING|STALLED|DIVERGING|INSUFFICIENT_DATA. It ships the READER ONLY (answers 2026-08-16 spike F5), changes NO agent-contract prose (dodges F4's blast radius), changes NO backlogit schema, and governs nothing (dodges the authority-expansion safety note). FALSIFICATION GATE ON EVERYTHING DOWNSTREAM: run it retrospectively against #229/#325/#328/#348 plus two healthy PRs; it MUST separate those populations. If it cannot, the convergence model is FALSIFIED and this entry should be CLOSED rather than staged further. STAGE GATE CONCLUSION: requirements are NOT genuinely ready -- no impl-plan, no plan-harden, no plan-review, no harvest, no shipment this session. OPERATOR AUTHORITY REQUIRED ON: Q1 may a convergence verdict ever BLOCK a merge (authority-expanding, Phase 3 only); Q2 is DIVERGING always pathological (093-S notes novel safety-critical code legitimately invites deep iterative scrutiny); Q3 does backlogit get any change at all (MVE needs none; Phase 2 might want a regression_of link type); Q4 should this entry be SPLIT into (a) PR-review convergence [now executable] and (b) reasoning-state identity [still blocked] -- recommended but NOT executed, since splitting a living tracker is an operator-visible reclassification. SECOND DELIBERATION 2026-08-25 (029-DL) -- OPERATOR-DIRECTED WIDENING, artifact docs/decisions/2026-08-25-dag-as-steering-mechanism-determinism-opportunity-map.md. Stage route claude-opus-5/anthropic/high. STILL NOT ARCHIVED -- entry remains ACTIVE at MEDIUM as the living tracker. OPERATOR PUSHBACK (verbatim intent): "I'm not convinced that a DAG is not a useful tool in this toolbox... think expansively about how a DAG can be incorporated into autoharness workflows as a steering mechanism towards greater determinism in outcome delivery." VERDICT: the pushback is CORRECT. 028-DL is NOT overturned but IS RE-SCOPED -- from a general verdict on DAGs to a specific and correct verdict about OPEN-NODE-SET convergence graphs. THREE RESPECTS IN WHICH THE PRIOR FRAMING WAS TOO NARROW: (1) property selection -- 028-DL tested the DAG against TERMINATION, the single one of six determinism properties a DAG provably CANNOT deliver, and generalized that negative; (2) node-set assumption -- "the node set is not fixed" is TRUE for review findings and FALSE almost everywhere else (plan units close at plan-review, shipment manifests close at assembly, pack composition closes at install), and over closed sets a DAG delivers coverage/reachability as genuine PROOF; (3) scope of claim -- correct for that graph, false as a statement about DAGs in this harness. SIX DETERMINISM PROPERTIES DISAMBIGUATED: D1 reproducibility (attainable ONLY inside the hermetic installer), D2 choice elimination (DAG delivers, needs a deterministic total order), D3 coverage proof (DAG delivers over closed sets, needs completion predicates), D4 termination (DAG CANNOT -- needs a monotone measure; this is 028-DL's result), D5 memoization (CANNOT for agent nodes -- non-hermetic, non-content-addressable, stochastic executor), D6 auditability (DAG delivers, needs resolvable evidence edges). SECOND REFRAME: REPORT-ONLY IS NOT NON-STEERING. compute_next_eligible (115-F) is read-only, honors P-001/P-016, creates no scheduler, and yet UNIQUELY DETERMINES the next shipment via a total order. Steering comes from CONSTRAINING CHOICE, not from scheduling -- so the dag-readiness no-scheduler NON-GOAL is RESPECTED and does NOT need revisiting (option (a), not (b)). EMPIRICAL GROUND TRUTH measured over 964 artifacts this session: 452 task-to-task blocks edges exist and NO analyzer reads them (dark data = the F5 written-but-unread failure, present TODAY); the only graph with a reader carries 26 edges across 149 shipments, which is why dag-readiness reports a critical path of 2 NODES over 149 shipments; only 24/149 shipments declare dependencies and only 1/149 uses queue_position, so ~84% of shipment ordering is carried by an UNDECLARED numeric-ID convention that pipeline-topology is forced to reverse-engineer in _prior_shipment_id -- a heuristic that has produced TWO consecutive recorded correctness defects (docs/compound/2026-08-18-topology-gate-multi-hop-reverse-dependency-fallback.md, severity medium; docs/compound/2026-08-18-topology-gate-forward-dependent-suppression-residual-defect.md, severity HIGH). MISSING GRAPH STRUCTURE HAS ALREADY SHIPPED BUGS IN THIS REPO. Read-only prototype found 44 real findings invisible to every existing tool: 9 MALFORMED dependency endpoints (literal '["003.001-T"]' JSON-string leaked into YAML, undetected for 4 months), 3 orphan tasks, 11 tasks in NO shipment manifest, 21 cross-shipment task edges with NO declared shipment-level ordering (33% of 63), 0 cycles. ARCHITECTURE RECOMMENDED: ONE node namespace (Universal Artifact Reference: bl:/path:/git:/gh:), SEVERAL typed edge families each declaring owner + source of truth + validity rule + REQUIRED reader -- explicitly NOT one merged graph (that would repeat 028-DL 2.1's four-graphs-collided error). TWO ARCHITECTURAL LAWS: (L1) DERIVE, NEVER PERSIST -- graphs are computed as views at read time from the markdown that already exists, which DISSOLVES 028-DL 2.2's disposable-cache data-loss objection structurally and means ZERO new storage, ZERO new schema, ZERO backlogit change for every keep candidate; (L2) NO GRAPH WITHOUT A READER, NO READER WITHOUT A BINDING -- the anti-F5 law. CROSS-REPO BOUNDARY EXTENDED: backlogit stores edges, autoharness interprets them; backlogit MUST NEVER learn that a task-level blocks edge implies a shipment-level ordering. RANKED KEEPS: (1) backlog graph integrity + edge lift + coverage [LOW blast, ZERO authority, prototyped]; (2) cross-reference integrity graph [makes F5 mechanically detectable -- an artifact with zero inbound reference edges is PROVABLY never read]; (3) evidence/provenance graph [closure conditions' evidence refs are checked NON-EMPTY but NEVER RESOLVED -- a closure citing a nonexistent file passes TODAY]; (4) plan-as-DAG [HIGHEST determinism yield overall -- converts "every requirement maps to an implementation unit" from prose judgment into a reachability proof -- but MEDIUM-HIGH blast radius on agent-contract prose, the F4 objection]; (5) install/tune composition graph [install_layers is a hand-maintained linearization of an undeclared DAG; the installer is the ONE hermetic island where D1/D5 are legitimately attainable]. PRUNED AS CARGO-CULT DAG: quality-gate DAG (5 nodes in a known order = a table drawn as a graph; the real problem there is a CACHE KEY, already embryonic as gate_evidence.head_sha), policy-interaction DAG (contradiction/shadowing are LOGICAL not TOPOLOGICAL failures; a precedence DAG would be FALSE PRECISION -- the useful artifact is a cross-reference matrix), memoization DAG (fails all three hermeticity tests; keep HEAD-pinned INVALIDATION, reject CACHING). NEW TRIAGE HEURISTIC ESTABLISHED (A8): "must I INVENT node identity?" is the primary triage question for any future DAG candidate -- every surviving candidate uses externally-supplied identity (backlogit IDs, file paths, git SHAs, PR/thread node IDs), and the moment a proposal must invent stable IDs it inherits the exact blocker that has defeated the reasoning-state strand across five sessions. RECOMMENDED FIRST SLICE: read-only, report-only utoharness gate backlog-graph-integrity with six finding classes, modelled on the proven dag-readiness contract, ZERO new prose (dodges F4), reader-only (dodges F5), ZERO new authority, always exit 0 in v0. Its one open unknown -- shipment manifest format drift -- was CLOSED this session (items: present 149/149; covering feature derivable from item parents 141/149), so the slice is UNBLOCKED and PLAN-READY. PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFICATION TEST: (a) undeclared-ordering findings must correlate with the two recorded _prior_shipment_id defects, (b) at least one finding actionable on inspection, (c) total findings < ~100 or it is noise, and CRITICALLY (d) PROSPECTIVE -- over the next 3+ Stage harvest cycles the gate must fire at least once on NEWLY-CREATED structure before it ships; three consecutive clean harvests means the defect class is HISTORICAL and the gate should be DEMOTED to an occasional hygiene command. (a)-(c) are already satisfied by the prototype and are therefore weak as tests; (d) is the real one and CAN fail. STAGE GATE CONCLUSION: deliberation-only, NO impl-plan / plan-harden / plan-review / harvest / shipment -- BY CHOICE, NOT DEFERRAL. OPERATOR INTENT (plain language, two coupled ideas):

1. RANGE-DETERMINISTIC DECOMPOSITION AND SIZING. Explore a decomposition/sizing method that is deterministic within a range, such that no shipment ever exceeds a complexity/token threshold. The threshold value is YET TO BE DETERMINED — establishing it is part of what the spike should explore, not a given. The goal is that decomposition produces predictable, bounded shipment sizes rather than shipments whose true cost is only discovered during execution.

2. INDEPENDENT SESSION PER STAGE/SHIPMENT CYCLE. Require each Stage/shipment cycle to run in its own independent session. That session CLOSES when the shipment completes, and only then does a new session start.
